controls.title: MFA enforced for privileged administrator accounts
controls.objective: Every account holding the realm role admin has multi-factor authentication configured.
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve all members of the realm role admin via paginated GET /api/kc/roles/admin/users and verify totp is true for each account.
controls.expected: totp=true for every object from GET /api/kc/roles/admin/users
controls.risk: Without MFA, a single stolen privileged password allows full takeover of the identity provider and all connected critical functions.
controls.recommendation: Require OTP enrollment for all admin accounts and enforce MFA for the admin authentication flow.
controls.cause: MFA was likely left optional in the realm authentication configuration or administrator onboarding process.

controls.title: MFA enforced for users of critical system
controls.objective: Every user account in the realm, which supports critical or important functions, has multi-factor authentication configured.
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve all users via paginated GET /api/kc/users and verify totp is true for each account.
controls.expected: totp=true for every object from GET /api/kc/users
controls.risk: Without MFA, password-only authentication exposes critical functions to account takeover by phishing or credential stuffing.
controls.recommendation: Require OTP enrollment for all realm users and enforce MFA for the user authentication flow.
controls.cause: MFA was likely not made mandatory in the realm authentication flow or user lifecycle process.

controls.title: Strong password policy with length and complexity
controls.objective: The realm passwordPolicy requires minimum length of 12 characters with complexity requirements.
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve GET /api/kc/realm and parse passwordPolicy to verify length and complexity items are present.
controls.expected: passwordPolicy contains length(12) or greater and upperCase(1), lowerCase(1), digits(1) and specialChars(1)
controls.risk: Weak passwords can be guessed or brute-forced, leading to unauthorized access to critical identity services.
controls.recommendation: Set the realm password policy to enforce at least 12 characters with upper-case, lower-case, digit and special-character complexity.
controls.cause: The realm password policy was likely left at Keycloak defaults and never hardened to the internal standard.

controls.title: Account lockout after repeated login failures
controls.objective: Account lockout on repeated login failures is enabled and triggers after at most 5 failures.
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve GET /api/kc/realm and verify bruteForceProtected is true and failureFactor is less than or equal to 5.
controls.risk: Without lockout, attackers can perform unlimited online password-guessing attacks against all accounts.
controls.recommendation: Enable brute-force protection in the realm and set the failure threshold to 5 or fewer attempts.
controls.cause: Brute-force protection was likely never enabled or was configured with a permissive threshold.

controls.title: Idle session timeout limited to 15 minutes
controls.objective: Idle SSO sessions expire after at most 15 minutes and idle timeout is not disabled.
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve GET /api/kc/realm and verify ssoSessionIdleTimeout is set to 900 seconds or less.
controls.expected: ssoSessionIdleTimeout<=900 (seconds) and not disabled or zero
controls.risk: Overly long idle sessions allow session hijacking and unauthorized use of unattended workstations.
controls.recommendation: Set the realm idle session timeout to 900 seconds or less.
controls.cause: The realm session timeout was likely left at the Keycloak default value exceeding 15 minutes.

controls.title: Logging of administration actions
controls.objective: All administration actions are recorded as admin events in the realm.
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve GET /api/kc/realm and verify adminEventsEnabled is true.
controls.risk: Without admin audit logging, malicious or erroneous privileged changes cannot be detected, investigated or attributed.
controls.recommendation: Enable admin events recording in the realm and retain the logs in the central SIEM.
controls.cause: Admin event logging was likely never enabled during realm hardening.

controls.title: No generic or shared administrator accounts
controls.objective: No holder of the realm role admin is a generic or shared account, with each admin having a nominative username of form initiale.nom and a personal email.
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve all members of the realm role admin via paginated GET /api/kc/roles/admin/users and verify username and email are nominative and not function or shared-mailbox values.
controls.expected: username matches initiale.nom pattern and email is personal (not ops, admin, root or ops-partage@, admin@) for every object from GET /api/kc/roles/admin/users
controls.risk: Shared privileged accounts destroy accountability and allow uncontrolled, non-attributable administrator access.
controls.recommendation: Remove admin rights from all generic or shared accounts and replace them with nominative accounts.
controls.cause: Operational convenience likely led to creation of function accounts with admin rights without enforcing nominative provisioning.
